g.text: e0 = ~RST & ED & in_valid; ej = ~RST & ED & valid_q[j-1]. ctrl_in = in_valid, in_tag, decoded block; ctrl_out = out_valid, out_tag.

g.text: IW=DATA_W+16 (8 fractional guard bits); PW=IW+27; factors are signed Q21. Data registers have no reset; synchronous RST clears control state.
